qa.title: Q1941 (Jan. 16, 2026)
qa.question: If I have multiple cards with an "At the start of each opponent's main phase" ability triggering, in what order do I resolve them?
qa.answer: You may resolve them in any order. When an opponent proceeds to their main phase, all "At the start of each opponent's main phase" abilities are triggered and become pending. Then, you can choose the order in which you resolve the pending abilities.

qa.title: Q1947 (Jan. 16, 2026)
qa.question: If I choose options 1 and 4, can I draw 2 cards and look at them before selecting an enemy amulet on the field to destroy?
qa.answer: No. When required to select targets for any part of a card or ability, all targets must be selected before playing. So if you choose options 1 and 4, you first select an enemy amulet on the field, resolve option 1, then resolve option 4.
